jobs.title: Part-Time Armed Security Patrol - Flexible Shifts
jobs.description:
Allied Universal, North America’s leading security and facility services company, is seeking an Armed Security Officer - Part Time Patrol in San Antonio, TX. This role offers reliable, fixed hours with opportunities to pick up extra shifts through our scheduling platform.

You will perform armed patrols, monitor access points, respond to incidents, and complete detailed reports while delivering professional customer service at the client site.

jobs.title: Armed Retail Patrol Officer (Level III) - Part-Time
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is hiring an Elite Security Officer - Level III Armed Patrol in San Antonio, TX. This part-time armed patrol role involves conducting regular vehicle and foot patrols, maintaining a visible presence to deter incidents, and delivering exceptional customer service at a retail location.

You will respond to incidents with professionalism, comply with site procedures, and complete detailed incident reports. A valid Level III Armed Guard Card and state licensing are required.

jobs.title: Armed Security Lead — TS/SCI w/ Poly (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
Patriot Group International LLC (PGI) is hiring an Armed Security Officer to support San Antonio operations. The role reports to the Site Manager and is responsible for leading force-protection security operations to deter sophisticated threats.

A TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required. Ideal candidates will have at least 1 year of security or law enforcement experience or 2 years of military service, be at least 21, and able to complete Texas DPS commissioned officer certification.
